definitions: A disreputable fellow, a good-for-nothing, a scapegrace, a blackguard
A badly behaved person, especially a child; a mischief-maker; a rascal

blocks.text: Scallywag magazine was published in London between 1991 and 1995. The subtitle of issues 1 - 6 was "Camden's only alternative community magazine". It sought to publish controversial journalism which other satirical and investigative publications were said to be unwilling to publish over fears of litigation. It was founded and edited by Simon Regan and Angus James, Regan's half-brother.
